Tim — thanks for the checklist. High level plan below; I'll paste a short actionable run order and attach our trimmed runbook and a quick-check template.

High-level lift & verify run order (summary):
- Preflight (30m): ACL snapshot confirm, BGP / routes learned, NTP check, KV cache warmup test.
- Service bring-up (30–45m): Start serving runtime in maintenance mode -> load model artifacts -> health probes -> enable traffic drain window.
- Canary traffic (30m): 1% traffic to canary pool (canary checks + latency SLO monitoring).
- Full cutover (15m): Gradually increase routing weight -> monitor error rates & token throughput.
- Post-cutover quickchecks (20m): run the attached quickcheck list from both sides and archive logs.

Manual gates we expect:
1) ACL & route verification (signoff by Acme infra)
2) Canary SLAs met for 30m (green)
3) No severe errors in service logs for 15m after ramp

I'll own coordinating the runbook playback; Marissa will run the post-deploy validation on our side. Attaching: runbook_v2.pdf (trimmed to just the execution steps) and postdeploy_quickcheck_template.md.

Mina Haddad
Director, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0142

Adding a concise ops checklist for the night of execution — please read and ack items you own. I've included the expected success criteria so we can sign off quickly.

Ops checklist (Marissa):
- Validate ACLs applied to the gateway and Midland firewall -> expected: inbound from Redwood VPC ranges only (signoff: Acme infra)
- NTP drift < 200ms across serving nodes -> expected: all nodes show <200ms
- Storage mounts read-write, model artifacts checksum match -> expected: checksums match SHA256 in runbook
- Health endpoint /_status returns 200 for all replicas -> expected: 5/5 replicas healthy
- Canary validation: p95 latency < 450ms, error rate < 0.5% for 30m -> expected: green
- Rollback triggers: sustained error rate >2% for 5m OR p95 > 1500ms -> action: traffic rollback and escalate to on-call

Attachments included: network_acl_snapshot_20270828.txt (for quick diff)

Marissa Cole
Sr. TPM, Redwood Inference

Ran the canary rehearsal in our staging mirror this morning and attaching a short tail of the canary run (truncated). Highlights:
- Canary run completed: 35m, p95=430ms, error rate=0.12%
- Observed a transient 502 burst during artifact load at t+3m (root cause: short-lived mount latency). We mitigated by increasing mount retry backoff for the rollout.
- KV cache warmup completed in 28s on a cold node when prefetch set to 80%

Excerpt (canary_results_0829.log):
[08:29:13] canary: start
[08:31:06] probe: p95 latency 412ms
[08:34:22] error: 502 burst (3) -> retry backoff applied
[08:35:00] canary: sustained green -> full stop

I recommend we include the mount retry tweak in the preflight and watch the first artifact load carefully.

Dylan Brooks
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Upcoming on-prem cutover window (Sept 1-2) - readiness check / final execution log

Team — final quick execution log and sign-off notes. We executed the plan inside the 02:00–05:45 UTC window. Summary:
- Preflight: ACLs confirmed (Acme signoff at 02:05 UTC), NTP drift max 87ms, storage mounts verified, artifact checksums matched.
- Service bring-up: all replicas came up in maintenance mode; initial artifact load encountered a single mount latency 502 spike, mount-retry behavior handled it; no manual rollback required.
- Canary: 30m window, p95=438ms, error rate=0.31% (within expected).
- Ramp: gradual traffic weight increase over 12m; observed minor token-throttle transient at t+7m (mitigated by temporary concurrency bump).
- Post-cutover quickchecks: executed the attached quickcheck from both sides; Acme reported successful end-to-end flow tests.

Open items and actions:
- Artifact mount retry: add the increased backoff to the baseline config (owner: Dylan) — due EOD Sept 3.
- Post-deploy log retention: archive first 72 hours at 30-day hot retention then cold to blob (owner: Markus).
- Draft a short blameless note for the one transient token-throttle event; propose to circulate tomorrow (owner: Mina).

Final: Go-live successful. Marking this thread as closed; I've uploaded the execution logs and quickcheck results to the linked Drive folder.

Thanks everyone for fast coordination.

Mina Haddad
Director, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0142
